text:
Maria (AE): Hey team — StrataOne sent an RFI this morning, they want a capability matrix + a short written QA for security and a POC window next month. Can we confirm who owns the matrix and the POC runbook?

Jasper (SE): I can own the matrix and the POC plan. Do we have preferences for hosted vs dedicated for the POC? StrataOne said data residency + HSM are deal breakers.

Lee (Security): HSM + KMS required. We'll need to answer their questionnaire Q12 about key custody and export controls. I can draft the text but need the exact deployment option (Private VPC or Dedicated with HSM) to be precise.

Olivia (PM): Product note: feature parity is the same for embeddings/generation across Hosted/Dedicated, but Private has the optional customer-managed KMS and audit logs. Call that out in the matrix as "KMS: vendor-managed (Hosted) / customer-managed (Private)".

Maria (AE): Good. StrataOne also asked two pricing variants: POC (30 days) and committed Dedicated (12 months). Can we give a back-of-envelope for committed GPU pool pricing and a POC trial price? They need numbers in the RFP.

Jasper (SE): For POC we usually offer a small reserved burst in Dedicated or a Private eval image. Suggested POC pricing: "dev bundle" at $5k flat for 30 days (includes telemetry + 16GB GPU burst). For committed 12mo Dedicated: I'll propose a tier note: "from $Xk/mo per GPU unit" and mark as indicative — finance to fill exact.

Lee (Security): I'll attach a short paragraph for Q12: we support customer-managed keys via CMKs in major KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and on-prem HSM via PKCS#11 integrators. Include SLA around key-access auditing.

Maria (AE): Can someone drop the capability_matrix CSV and a one-page POC ops checklist into the thread so I can attach them to the RFP doc?

Deploy Bot: capability_matrix_strataone_v1.csv uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/capability_matrix_strataone_v1.csv

Jasper (SE): Uploaded POC_runbook_strataone_v1.md and a sample env bootstrap snippet. snippet:

```
# bootstrap
redwood-cli init --project strataone-poc --mode dedicated --region us-west-2
redwood-cli create-env --type gpu --count 1 --image rwinference/poc:latest
```

Maria (AE): Perfect. For the RFI narrative, I'll use product/SE text for features and Lee's security paragraph for the KMS section. Finance: can you confirm the committed pricing delta by EOD so I can finalize the response? (cc @Finance) :pray:

Olivia (PM): One more product point to call out: canary rollouts + fallback models are supported and can be enforced via routing policy — useful for their reliability question. Add a short bullet.

Lee (Security): Also adding note about SOC2 audit reports + pen test cadence. I can attach the redacted SOC2 summary once legal signs off.

Maria (AE): Thanks — I'm pulling everything into the RFP doc now. Will send a draft to Jasper/Lee for sign-off before 4pm PT.

Jasper (SE): Reviewing now, will ping with any gap notes.

Lee (Security): On it. If legal delay on SOC2, we can still answer Q9 with S3 gated link and ETA.

Maria (AE): Awesome. If we can finalize the matrix + POC checklist in the next 2 hours I can meet their noon deadline for initial packet. :rocket:
